title: Sources
description: Only selected sources are used in the chat and in the Studio.

empty.title: Add your first source
empty.body: Upload a PDF, EPUB, Markdown or text file, add a web page, or paste text.

readOriginalInStudy: Open the original in Study to read it and make image flashcards.
citationChanged: This citation points to a passage that has changed or moved.
unavailable: This source is no longer available
savedStudyDescription: You can still read the text saved in Study.

delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.body: It will be removed from this notebook. Chats and outputs made from it are kept.

addDialog.title: Add sources
addDialog.description: Sources stay in this browser. Their text is sent to your model when you ask questions or create something.
addDialog.fileTypes: PDF, EPUB, Markdown or text files, up to 20 MB each.
addDialog.urlHint: The page's main text is saved as a source.
addDialog.textPlaceholder: Paste notes, an article or a transcript

errors.empty: No text could be read from {{name}}.
errors.type: {{name}} is not a supported file type.
errors.url: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.

transcript.title: Add a video or podcast
transcript.description: Save its transcript as a document you can read, highlight and practise with.
transcript.linkLabel: Link to the video or episode (optional)
transcript.linkHint: Saved at the top of the transcript so you can go back to it. Nothing is downloaded from it.
transcript.linkInvalid: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
transcript.pasteTip: On YouTube, open the video's description, choose Show transcript, then select the text and copy it. Its times become [mm:ss] marks.
transcript.subtitlesDrop: Drop an SRT or VTT file here
transcript.subtitlesHint: Subtitles are read on this device. Lines repeated by automatic captions are kept once.
transcript.recordingDrop: Drop an audio or video file here
transcript.longer: For a longer recording, split it into parts, upload its subtitles or paste its transcript.
transcript.sentTo: The recording is sent to {{provider}} with your API key. This app doesn't keep it.
transcript.noProvider: To transcribe recordings, add an OpenAI or ElevenLabs API key in Settings → AI providers. You can still paste a transcript or upload subtitles.
transcript.takesAWhile: This can take a few minutes for a long recording.

errors.tooLarge: {{name}} is larger than {{size}} MB. Split it into parts, or use its subtitles or transcript.
errors.stopped: The transcription of {{name}} stopped before it finished. Try again.
errors.subtitlesType: {{name}} is not an SRT or VTT file.
